title: LatexDo 1.0
summary: PDF reading themes, live word counts, a simpler literature graph, and improvements to everyday editing.

highlights.title: Read PDFs in your preferred theme
highlights.description: Choose original, sepia, dark, midnight, or the app theme for your PDF preview. Your choice is saved without changing the exported PDF.

highlights.title: Word counts as you write
highlights.description: See the abstract and file total in the status bar. Right-click a heading for chapter, section, and subsection counts, with an explanation of what is included.

highlights.title: A simpler literature graph
highlights.description: Explore related papers with a clearer graph workspace and less crowded controls.

highlights.title: Open a folder by dropping it into LatexDo
highlights.description: Choose whether to add the folder to a research space or open it in a new window.

highlights.title: Release notes included with the app
highlights.description: Read the release summary after updating or from Help → What’s New, even without an internet connection.

fixes: Turning off intelligent completion hides inline grey suggestions while keeping the normal completion list.
Delete individual notifications using the trash button shown on hover.
Added association social links to About.

security.title: Updates come only from LatexDo's release repository
security.description: LatexDo installs updates only from latexdo.org downloads and the latexdo/latexdo-desktop releases, and checks every installer against the signed update feed.
